block.kultivator.earthfire_forge.tooltip: Forges artifacts and storage rings. Its heat comes from the block below: a campfire, magma, lava or a soul campfire.
block.kultivator.earthfire_forge.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 520, 928 (a refining room; the Earthfire Hall heated by depth). The block and its numbers are game design.
item.kultivator.forged_artifact.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 415, 1237, 1393; A Will Eternal ch. 5, 29-38 (enhancement). Grades: inspired by Battle Through the Heavens. Numbers: game design.
item.kultivator.storage_pouch.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 190, 273, 402 (storage pouches, spoils of a fight). Slots and recipe: game design.
item.kultivator.storage_ring_low.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 267 (items taken out of a storage ring). Tier, 18 slots, recipe and rules: game design.
item.kultivator.storage_ring_mid.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 267, 867 (a ring bound by a spiritual imprint). Tier, 27 slots, recipe and rules: game design.
item.kultivator.storage_ring_high.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 1353 (energy cores kept in a storage ring). Tier, 36 slots, recipe and rules: game design.
item.kultivator.storage_ring_supreme.sou: Source: Battle Through the Heavens ch. 267, 867, 1353. Tier, 54 slots, recipe and rules: game design.
kultivator.tempa.ring.refuse_item: Rings, pouches, shulker boxes and bundles cannot go inside a storage ring.
kultivator.tempa.grade.0.source: Source: Yellow grade: the grade ladder is inspired by Battle Through the Heavens; Innate True Fire suffices (A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 156).
kultivator.tempa.grade.1.source: Source: Mystic grade: a campfire's Common Fire suffices (game design); grade name inspired by Battle Through the Heavens.
kultivator.tempa.grade.2.source: Source: Earth grade: Earth Fire, A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 156, 928.
kultivator.tempa.grade.3.source: Source: Heaven grade: Earth Lung Fire, A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 156.
kultivator.tempa.grade.4.source: Source: Immortal grade: the deep pit of the Earthfire Hall, A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 928.
kultivator.tempa.grade.5.source: Source: Divine grade: inspired by the Heavenly Flames of Battle Through the Heavens.
kultivator.tempa.spirit.0.source: Source: Spiritless: no spirit has formed yet.
kultivator.tempa.spirit.1.source: Source: Spirit Seed: game design; inspired by the Martial Peak idea that a spirit must first be planted.
kultivator.tempa.spirit.2.source: Source: Elementary Spirit: Martial World ch. 1128 (an elementary artifact spirit that seems to act with its own will).
kultivator.tempa.spirit.3.source: Source: Complete Spirit: Martial World ch. 1128, 1132 (tribulation tempering makes a full spirit artifact).

kultivator.screen.help.tempa.title: Forging
kultivator.screen.help.tempa: Build an Earthfire Forge and put fire under it: a campfire (Mystic), magma (Earth), lava or magma over lava (Heaven), the same below y 0 (Immortal), or a soul campfire with a Heavenly Flame seed (Divine). Put an embryo, metal, a core, up to 2 stones and a herb in the 9 slots; the card shows the grade, what limits it and the chance. Materials are used only when the channel ends; closing the forge returns them.
kultivator.screen.help.pusaka_diri.title: Your Natal Treasure
kultivator.screen.help.pusaka_diri: From Golden Core, hold a Mystic+ artifact, press Bind in Scroll › Self › Treasure (or /kultivasi pusaka ikat) and meditate for 30 s with 4 Mid stones: it sinks into your body and its form works always, ×1.25. A natal sword strikes with your bare hand. Release returns it with 5 min of Qi Deviation. You may link 2 more artifacts. Reforge it at the forge with Natal switched on (+1 to +12).
kultivator.screen.help.roh_senjata.title: Weapon Spirit
kultivator.screen.help.roh_senjata: Your natal treasure ages while you meditate (1 year a minute), with technique kills of strong foes and with cores of its element. Heaven grade and 100 years take a spirit seed; 400 years bring the Elementary Spirit, which acts on its own; 1,000 years, Immortal grade and a tribulation make it Complete. A Beast Soul gives an artificial Elementary Spirit at once, but it never becomes Complete.
kultivator.screen.help.cincin.title: Storage Rings
kultivator.screen.help.cincin: Craft a pouch (9 slots) at a crafting table and forge rings of 18 to 54 slots at the Earthfire Forge. Sneak + use or the Open Ring key opens one. The first opening plants your soul imprint: only you can open it or pick it up when it drops, and fire, lava and explosions do not destroy it. Rings, shulker boxes and bundles cannot go inside. A ring still drops on death.
